title: Zoom Annotation Flaws Could Let a Meeting Participant Hijack Another Attendee's Client
summary: Anyone sharing their screen on a Zoom call could have taken over the computers of everyone watching, and anyone watching could have taken over the presenter's.
card_summary: Anyone sharing their screen on a Zoom call could have taken over the computers of everyone watching, and anyone watching could have taken over the presenter's.

sections.technical: The flaw sat in the annotation tool, the feature that lets participants draw and type on a shared screen, and it asked nothing of the victim beyond being in the meeting.

email_summary: Anyone sharing their screen on a Zoom call could have taken over the computers of everyone watching, and anyone watching could have taken over the presenter's. The flaw sat in the annotation tool, the feature that lets participants draw and type on a shared screen, and it asked nothing of the victim beyond being in the meeting.

title: Sandworm-Linked UAC-0145 Uses Fake Job Interviews to Push VPN That Can Run Commands
